summary.text: Thought to have been a son of the river Cayster; with the aboriginal Coresus he founded Artemis' sanctuary, and from him the Ionian city received its name.

story.text: Pausanias records that the Ephesian sanctuary was not founded by Amazons — though Amazon women sacrificed there from of old — but by Coresus an aboriginal and Ephesus, whom they believe to have been a son of the river Cayster; from Ephesus the city took its name.
